crossRefs.note: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?
crossRefs.keyword: the thing that I long for. Heb. my expectation

crossRefs.note: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father;’ to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’
crossRefs.keyword: the thing that I long for. Heb. my expectation

crossRefs.note: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.
crossRefs.keyword: the thing that I long for. Heb. my expectation

translations.web: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,
translations.bsb: If only my request were granted and God would fulfill my hope:
translations.kjv: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!
translations.asv: Oh that I might have my request; And that God would grant me the thing that I long for!
